items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: The first band I ever got in with was Kid Rene.

ctx.x: What was the first band you played with?

The first band I ever got in with was Kid Rene. Kid Rene. Kid Rene come to my house and told me, asked me didn't I want to play with him. And I told him I didn't know if I could play good enough. He said, oh yes, I know you can play good enough. He said, sure. I said, I heard you playing around. He said, you play swell. He said, you come on. He said, you'll never get no place if you don't get in the band and go head on and play. Now that's the words he told me. So I said, well alright then. I said, I hope I don't…
Who else was in that band, do you remember?

items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] After Kid Renee, after you left Kid Renee. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I played with Papa Celestan quite a bit. And, uh, and I played with, uh, with, uh, I played with Kid Howard too.

ctx.x: Well, I got, see I got, today I like Mike on trumpet, Mike DeLay. Yeah, he is very good. I like Mike DeLay on trumpet very much. And now back further, I think the kid was great. Kid Renee. Kid Renee, yeah, I think he was great. And another boy is very good too. He's nice, he had a kind of stroke now, but he's always, he was always, well with me, I mean for his playing is concerned, it was Kid Howard. Oh, Kid Howard. And another guy I like, he was kind of weak, but I liked him too. It was Elmer Talbot called…
How did Kid Renee play? Did he play low or high or?
